title: Implementation and coverage do not grant approval
preconditions: Disposable Saga has proposed System, Component and data entity plus a committed design and review with no verification, integration or approval records; capture their public histories.

steps.action: Record implemented successors with scoped resolvable evidence and explicit delivery commits.
steps.expected_result: Proposal history is retained and selected intent changes only for the delivered revisions.

steps.action: Read quality, review and work histories before and after implementation; inspect code currency independently.
steps.expected_result: Implementation created no verification, integration or review approval; currency remains a separate fact.

steps.action: Add canonical entity references and scoped selections to the delivery design/review, then inspect approval and unexplained changed code.
steps.expected_result: References and inherited implementation coverage create no review approval and unrelated changed code stays unexplained.
